    """The (color, side) of the solid block at the center of a rectangle: its color and smaller side."""
    inner = grid[(r0 + r1) // 2][(c0 + c1) // 2]
    icells = [(i, j) for i in range(r0, r1 + 1) for j in range(c0, c1 + 1) if grid[i][j] == inner]
    rs = [c[0] for c in icells]; cs = [c[1] for c in icells]
    return inner, min(max(rs) - min(rs) + 1, max(cs) - min(cs) + 1)

    """Thickness of the rectangle border at (r0, c0), measured down its column cm to the first other color."""
    oc = grid[r0][c0]
    t = 1

    return t
